_about: epic-dod.mjs config. NOTE (2026-09-28): the alias `golden-frijoles` means the SKILLS repo (golden-frijoles/skills), because historical sprint docs use it that way. This repo was renamed to danybgoode/golden-frijoles and is still aliased as `golden-beans`, so cite it that way. `aliases` maps how sprint docs name a repo to owner/repo. `exemptions` excuse ONE derived item on ONE epic closed before a convention existed, with the reason; an exemption on an item that now passes is STALE and fails the check.
